Remote - Senior Network and Cloud Security Engineer
description:
Location: 100% remote 
 Shift: General (Overlap with PST) 
 Role Overview 
 Both openings are for a Senior Network and Cloud Security Engineer role. Candidates should possess 7-10 years of cybersecurity/security engineering experience. 
 The focus is on security engineering experience, not cyber assurance, audit, governance, risk, compliance, or policy-oriented backgrounds. Candidates should have foundational security knowledge with strong expertise in network security. 
 Core Technical Requirements 
 Network Security (Primary Skill) 
 Candidates should have hands-on expertise in: 
 Firewalls Switches Routers Security configurations and security profiles VPN management and configurations Network traffic security controls Firewall policy management and auditing These areas constitute the primary focus of the role. 
 Cloud Security (Mandatory) Candidates should have working knowledge of: 
 AWS Azure GCP Cloud networking and cloud security concepts Security Groups Cloud-native network controls Network security enforcement policies WAF (Web Application Firewall) DDoS Protection Services Awareness of securing cloud services and cloud network architecture is required. 
 Engineering and Automation Skills Candidates should have: Security engineering mindset Automation experience Infrastructure-as-Code exposure Understanding of CI/CD pipelines Ability to develop automation solutions Technologies mentioned: Terraform CloudFormation AWS User Data Scripts Python or other scripting languages Strong automation capabilities are highly valued. 
 AI Experience 
 Experience leveraging AI tools for coding and automation is considered a positive differentiator. Examples mentioned include AI-assisted code generation tools. Candidates with hands-on experience using AI for automation development will be viewed favorably. ________________________________________ Skill Priority Discussion Must-Have Skills 
 Network Security is mandatory. Cloud Security is mandatory. Candidates should possess both competencies. Nice-to-Have Skills DevSecOps AI Engineering Advanced Automation Skills These are preferred but not mandatory. 
 Desired Skill Weightage 
 60-70% Network Security 20-30% Cloud Security Engineering/Automation skills are an important differentiator Candidates with strong networking expertise and moderate cloud exposure may still be considered, provided they understand cloud networking fundamentals. ________________________________________ Experience Expectations Security Experience Overall cybersecurity/security experience: 7-10 years. Experience can span:  Security Operations (SOC) Incident Response Other relevant cybersecurity domains Such foundational security experience is considered valuable. Network Security Experience Candidates with 5-7 years of focused network administration/network security experience are viewed very positively. ________________________________________ Project Scope 
 Automation Projects 
 Candidates may be required to: 
 Integrate firewalls with device management platforms such as Intune. Develop scripts consuming APIs from multiple systems. Read and write data through APIs. Build operational automation solutions. Scripting language choice is flexible and may include: Python Bash Any language the candidate is proficient in. 
 Infrastructure as Code Projects Candidates may be required to: 
 Provision security groups. Automate cloud deployments. Build infrastructure using Terraform or user data scripts. Support cloud network security automation initiatives. 
 ________________________________________ Terraform Expectations 
 Terraform is considered a nice-to-have skill. Intermediate-level knowledge is sufficient. Candidates are not expected to be highly proficient. Ability to contribute and create a functional first draft is considered adequate because peer review support will be available from existing engineers. ________________________________________

Key Skills: Cloud Security,Network Security,Routing,Switching,Firewall,AWS Security,Senior,Network engineering
